author: ABMN Staff
title: Stock Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 3rd (AAPL, AYI, CISN, CQP, ETN, FDC, FTV, IMGN, LNG, MA)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Jan 3rd, 2019 // No Comments
Stock Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Thursday, January 3rd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target cut by Piper Jaffray Companies from $222.00 to $187.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
Acuity Brands (NYSE:AYI) had its market perform rating reissued by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. Credit Suisse Group AG currently has a $128.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $135.00.
Goldman Sachs Group Inc assumed coverage on shares of Cision (NYSE:CISN) . Goldman Sachs Group Inc issued a neutral rating on the stock.
UBS Group AG initiated coverage on shares of Cheniere Energy Partners (NYSEAMERICAN:CQP) . UBS Group AG issued a neutral rating on the stock.
Eaton (NYSE:ETN) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a $80.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $85.00.
First Data (NYSE:FDC) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Mizuho. The firm currently has a $21.00 target price on the stock.
Fortive (NYSE:FTV) had its neutral rating reissued by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. Credit Suisse Group AG currently has a $78.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $86.00.
ImmunoGen (NASDAQ:IMGN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The analysts wrote, “Our 12-month, $18 price target on shares of ImmunoGen is based on a 13-year DCF-driven, sum-of-the-parts analysis. Our DCF analysis is based on: beta of 1.8, terminal growth rate of 0.5%, risk premium of 4.93%, calculated WACC of 12.0%, and tax rate of 12% beginning in FY 2028. Note, our $18 price target is leveraged on the outcome of the mirvetuximab soravtansine’s Phase 3 FORWARD I study, which represents approximately 89% of our target (risk-adjusted NPV of $16 per share). Key risks to our valuation include: emergence of ADC-related safety concerns, clinical, regulatory, and financials risks. ImmunoGen, Inc.””
UBS Group AG assumed coverage on shares of Cheniere Energy (NYSEAMERICAN:LNG) . They issued a buy rating on the stock.
Mastercard (NYSE:MA) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
3M (NYSE:MMM) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. Credit Suisse Group AG currently has a $220.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $230.00.
Needham & Company LLC started coverage on shares of NeoGenomics (NASDAQ:NEO) . They issued a buy rating on the stock.
Norfolk Southern (NYSE:NSC) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Argus.
William Blair initiated coverage on shares of OptimizeRx (NASDAQ:OPRX) . The firm issued an outperform rating on the stock.
People’s United Financial (NASDAQ:PBCT) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
Solaris Oilfield Infrastructure (NYSE:SOI) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. Piper Jaffray Companies currently has a $17.50 price target on the stock.
Citigroup Inc started coverage on shares of United Technologies (NYSE:UTX) . Citigroup Inc issued a neutral rating on the stock.
Worldpay (NYSE:WP) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Mizuho. The firm currently has a $100.00 price target on the stock.
